evidenceSources: Phase 2.5 — Git history: all detectors authored by Subodh (subodhkc, subodh@haiec.com), first commit 2026-01-04, latest 2026-08-01
Phase 2.5 — External similarity: 2228 external rules compared, 0 strong/exact matches, 3 generic similarity (expected for common security patterns), 118 no meaningful match
Phase 2.5 — Classification: STRONG_HAIEC_ORIGIN_EVIDENCE for all 121 detectors (now 122 after rc.6 split)

rationale.originEvidence_STRONG: Git authorship records show all detectors were authored by Subodh. External similarity check against 2228 rules found 0 strong/exact matches. This constitutes STRONG evidence of HAIEC origin.
rationale.licenseDisposition_HAIEC_CAN_LICENSE: No third-party copying found. All detectors are HAIEC-authored. HAIEC can license under the final package license.
rationale.finalLegalDisposition_PENDING_HUMAN_REVI: Human/legal review remains a required gate before publication. STRONG origin evidence does NOT eliminate the need for human/legal approval. PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW is compatible with STRONG origin evidence.

importantClarification: PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW does NOT require originEvidence to be INCOMPLETE. A detector can have STRONG origin evidence AND still require human/legal review. The previous A2 run incorrectly set originEvidence=INCOMPLETE for all detectors, which discarded valid Phase 2.5 evidence. This A3 run restores the evidence-backed STRONG classification while keeping finalLegalDisposition=PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW.
whatWeDoNOTClaim: We do NOT claim human/legal review is complete
We do NOT claim PROVEN_HAIEC_ORIGINAL (that would require searching all private repos worldwide)
We do NOT infer legal authorship from similarity search alone (git history is the primary evidence)
